bindings.caption: Continue heating the high-MSC reaction mixture. Continue the source 0.52 mM F360 mixture with 70 equiv of In(My)3, Zn(St)2, and (TMS)3P as captioned in Figure S14, up to five days at 300 °C. This extended endpoint is distinct from the 90 min QD characterization; no exact physical-batch join, absolute precursor charge or conversion of equivalents to 35 mM is established. Conceptual process flow; vessel geometry, phase separation and particle shape are unassigned.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
